method.note: 2025 RUS awards model built from reported Deseret player stats, RUS 2025 team records and no estimated missing stats. All-State, All-Region and All-Utah position teams use the same shared position formulas as the live 2026 watch (2026-08-17-v1): QB/RB/WR/TE/ATH count passing + rushing + receiving only, defensive stats are excluded from those offensive positions, and run-first QBs receive enhanced rushing credit.
